tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects visible to the signed-in user (RLS applied). Supports filtering by status and free-text search on project name.

status.description: Filter by project_status (e.g. approvato, in_corso, completato).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on project name.

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Fetch a single project by id, with its client and basic metadata (RLS applied).

tools.name: list_my_time_entries
tools.title: List my time entries
tools.description: List time-tracking entries recorded by the signed-in user, optionally within a date range. Uses RLS so only the caller's data is returned.

tools.name: list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List confirmed time-tracking entries. Pass user_id (UUID) or user_search (a person's name/email). Admins can query any user; team leaders are limited to users in their assigned areas; other roles are limited to their own entries. Only entries with actual_start_time and actual_end_time set are returned. Returns the entries plus an aggregated summary (total hours, hours per project).

user_id.description: Filter by user UUID. Requires admin, or team_leader access to that user's area.

user_search.description: Alternative to user_id: a name or email fragment. If several users match, the tool returns the candidates instead of entries.

tools.name: get_project_summary
tools.title: Get project summary
tools.description: Return a summary of a project (visible to the signed-in user via RLS): planned budget and hours, confirmed hours and cost from time tracking, plus additional costs. Numbers reflect only rows the caller is allowed to see.

tools.name: find_users
tools.title: Find users
tools.description: Search approved TimeTrap users by name or email and return their UUIDs. Use this first to resolve a person's name into a user_id before calling list_time_entries. Admins can search everyone; team leaders only users in their areas; other roles only themselves.

query.description: Name, surname, full name or email fragment (case-insensitive).
